explication: Spinel turns Ruby source into a standalone native executable: it parses the program, builds an in-memory AST model, infers types, generates C, then compiles and links that C with the runtime. The `spin` project tool adds project scaffolding, dependency management, and build/run/test workflows around the compiler. The README documents the main pipeline; source excerpts and the index support the compiler entry point and runtime/package boundaries. Some implementation details are unsampled, so uncertain internal calls are omitted.
